thread:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: api-prod - elevated 5xx and timeouts detected. p99 latency jumped from ~180ms to ~5.2s at 2024-05-01T03:45Z. Error rate ~3.8%, increase in gateway timeouts. Runbook suggested: deploy-regression -> consider immediate rollback.

maria-oncall: Got the page, I'm on it. Starting triage.

sam-eng: I see a spike coincident with the canary rollout at 03:40Z — new batching change pushed in edge-serving.

tessa-sre: Dashboards: request queue depth up, backend instance CPU normal, but connection wait time is high. Looks like connection stall rather than CPU.

maria-oncall: @sam can you confirm which commit?

sam-eng: Commit b3f2a9c - changed batching settings + increased multiplex timeout. Reverting to prior config should be quick.

maria-oncall: Ok plan: 1) Rollback canary to previous config 2) Enable fallback routing 3) Notify customers if >1% errors persist after rollback.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-20240501-1732. Paging on-call escalation to @tessa-sre after 10m if no resolution.

maria-oncall: Rolling back canary now. Command:
```bash
deployctl rollback --service api-edge --target canary --to sha=b2d9c44 --reason "p99 latency regression"
```

sam-eng: Running rollback, will post status.

(30s) sam-eng: rollback started -> kube events show new rollout.

lia-support: Notifying customers via status page draft: "We are investigating elevated timeouts in inference API; degradations may be experienced. Engineering is rolling back a recent canary." Approving post.

(90s) tessa-sre: Observability: KV cache miss rates unchanged; connection pool saturation dropping. p99 trending down from 5.2s -> 620ms.

maria-oncall: Good sign. Keeping fallback routing for another 5m then re-evaluate.

kevin-prod: Any customer-impact metric? SLA alert threshold at 1% errors. Current peak was 3.8% but dropping to 0.9% after rollback.

lia-support: Posting update to statuspage: "Mitigation in progress; visible improvement after rollback. Follow-up message in 15 minutes." :white_check_mark:

(6m) sam-eng: Rollback complete; canary pods terminated, previous stable serving config restored.

ops-bot: Metric check scheduled in 2 minutes.

(8m) tessa-sre: p95 back to 240ms, p99 ~310ms, 5xx rate 0.7%. No new errors in logs aside from timeouts during rollout window.

maria-oncall: Closing incident? I want a short postmortem and follow-up to investigate batching change and multiplex timeout interaction. Assigning action items:
- sam-eng: investigate why multiplex timeout bump caused connection stalls.
- tessa-sre: add automated canary gating for p99 > 1s on api-edge.
- lia-support: customer comms follow-up and RCA summary.

sam-eng: Ack. I already bisected locally and will instrument more telemetry around batch flush timing.

lia-support: Preparing customer notification and RFC for next 24h.

maria-oncall: Marking INC-20240501-1732 as mitigated. Moving to postmortem backlog. Thanks everyone. :tada:

ops-bot: Incident status updated to MITIGATED by maria-oncall at 2024-05-01T03:53Z.

sam-eng: quick note — adding unit test for edge-batching timeout interactions and a canary preflight that rejects rollouts if p99 increases >2x in first 5m.

maria-oncall: Nice. Closing thread here, we'll collect logs/traces and start formal postmortem doc.
